run_formal uses label-free catalog and bounded training prefix; full label inventory calls are confined to preparation diagnostics and explicit scoring/evaluation/replay/validator interfaces

findings.title: training process receives only a label-free target and strict historical prefix
findings.evidence: run_formal no longer calls read_draws on its training path. load_target_catalog emits game/target_issue/ordinal/source_count only. read_training_prefix stops after source_count same-game rows and rejects target-or-future issues. The spawn worker receives only this sanitized payload and quarantines itself before payload inspection.

findings.title: trainer cannot mint or use the scoring capability
findings.evidence: scoring access now requires an opaque process-nonce and PID-bound capability. The trainer's first action permanently sets its process role to trainer; activate_scoring_capability then fails closed. A probe executed in the real spawn context was denied with number_read_count=0. The capability is not serialized into trainer payloads.

findings.title: guard validates persisted forecast and exact immutable release ledger before label read
findings.evidence: guarded_unlock requires canonical release-contained forecast and receipt paths, exact release ledger path, ledger object identity/run match, continuous global sequence, global latest event equal to the same experiment/attempt lock, complete lock identity/path/current SHA, and forecast release/run/game/target/model identity before _read_one. A release-external forged ledger is rejected with zero reads and no receipt.

findings.title: successful unlock receipt and event close all required bindings
findings.evidence: each receipt binds release/run/experiment/attempt/game/target/model, canonical forecast path/current lock SHA, label-store identity, label SHA, read ordinal and guard result. The label_unlocked event binds the receipt path/SHA and the same identities; metrics bind that receipt path/SHA.

findings.title: primary and standalone recomputation verify bottom-level guarded unlock evidence
findings.evidence: both recomputers verify canonical forecast and receipt paths, current forecast SHA, exact lock/unlock identities and run, globally adjacent latest lock, receipt/event/metric hashes, label-store identity, continuous ledger identity/sequence and equality of referenced versus actual receipt inventory. A synthetic canonical 600-record inventory passed 600/600 in both; global interleaving and wrong lock path mutations failed in both.

findings.title: required positive and negative implementation controls pass
findings.evidence: pre-lock, wrong lock hash, forecast rewrite, wrong release, wrong experiment, wrong attempt, wrong target, wrong ledger and real trainer capability access all reject before the instrumented label-number read; positive guarded unlock emits a bound receipt. Phase 3 regression is 42/42 PASS.

findings.title: requested /private/tmp location is unavailable on this Linux host
findings.evidence: the host has no writable /private; mkdir -p /private/tmp failed with permission denied. By parent direction both W06 records are stored under /tmp.
